audit.whatIsWrong: The chart marked Mordekaiser at Level 1 through 2+ items in a lane Shen wins 54.17% over 2701 games, and win[3] said Mordekaiser while whys[3] says 'Levels 4-5 favor Shen'.
audit.why: The packet chart and the already-audited mirror agree: Skill, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Shen, Mordekaiser, Shen, Shen. Shen concedes the early duel and takes over from first item.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 3, 5 and 6 flipped as matched full/content pairs with ratings.

audit.why: Spikes are right: Mordekaiser levels 2-3 on Death's Grasp, Shen at 6 for Stand United, then Sunfire/Heartsteel first item and the 2-item split window. Realm of Death at 140/120/100s is his fight-starting spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level-2 advice told you to trade when Realm of Death is down — his ultimate does not exist at level 2. Abilities were referred to only by slot letter.
audit.why: Death's Grasp (E, 700 range, 16/14/12/10/8s) is the ability that decides levels 2-5; Indestructible (W, 12/11/10/9/8s) converts stored damage into shield and heal, so Grievous Wounds decides extended trades; Realm of Death (R, 650 range, 140/120/100s) isolates you where Stand United cannot reach an ally.
audit.corrected: Level-2 row rekeyed to Death's Grasp; real names and cooldowns used; anti-heal timing named.

audit.whatIsWrong: The missingInteractions feed claims Obliterate (Q) grounds and denies Shadow Dash and Stand United.
audit.why: Riot's own description of Obliterate is damage only — 'smashes the ground with his mace dealing damage to each enemy struck' — with no grounding text. The grounding flag in champ-data/_kits/mordekaiser.json is a tooltip-parsing misfire, and the mirror audit flagged the same bug. Not asserted on the page.
audit.corrected: No edit made; recorded as unverified.

edits.before: W spirit zone blanks his auto window. Only take the trade when Mordekaiser's Realm of Death is down.
edits.after: Spirit's Refuge blanks his autos, not Obliterate — trade only after Death's Grasp is spent.

edits.before: Level 1 is genuinely even — both kits are partial, and Mordekaiser's Q isolation bonus is not yet dangerous without his E; feel out the trade but do not commit.
edits.after: Level 1 is genuinely even — Obliterate's isolation bonus is not yet dangerous without Death's Grasp to separate you; feel out the trade but do not commit anything.

edits.before: Mordekaiser's E pull comes online and he can drag you away from your spirit blade, starting a prolonged W-sustained trade he wins.
edits.after: Death's Grasp (E, 16s at rank 1) drags you off your spirit blade and starts the prolonged Indestructible-sustained trade he wins.

edits.before: Full Mordekaiser kit — his Q isolated slam, E pull, and W shield combine into a trade pattern that out-sustains your Ki Barrier shield; keep trades short and disengage after your E-taunt.
edits.after: Full kit — Obliterate, Death's Grasp (16s) and Indestructible (12s) out-sustain Ki Barrier, so keep trades short, disengage after Shadow Dash, and buy Grievous Wounds early.

edits.before: His 1v1 realm. W-block through it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Realm of Death is 140s at rank 1 — engage the window only once it is spent.

edits.before: Track Mordekaiser's Realm of Death: His 1v1 realm. W-block through it. When it is down — E-Q + R him.
edits.after: Realm of Death (140s at rank 1) isolates you where Stand United cannot reach allies. When it is down — E-Q him.

notes: champ-data/_kits/mordekaiser.json carries a grounding flag on Obliterate that Riot's description does not support; the missingInteractions 'dash-denied' headline derives from it and was NOT written to the page. Same bug the mordekaiser-side mirror audit reported. The packet's suspectNames here ('Use Realm of Death', 'Stand United's') are both false positives — correct Riot names.
